author: AtditC
body:
Hello Avicus Staff members!

Here you can see GreatTimo spleefing a player after the player spleefed GreatTimo, he called it "payback", however spleefed him twice.

Name of player being reported: GreatTimo
Rule broken: Team Spleefing > Team Killing
Evidence: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h1vj8pn9BUc
Anything else you would like to add? As I said above, the player he spleefed, spleefed him first and GreatTimo called it "payback" as you can see in the chat. Also, he already has an infraction for spleefing.

Greetings,
-Atdit
